As a result, gross profit grew at a stable rate, keeping in line with management\u2019s expectations. The company managed to reduce its financial leverage, leading to an improvement in its interest coverage ratio. Profitability remains strong, operational efficiency is improving, and the company\u2019s balance sheet reflects a stable, low-risk financial structure.
